borolla.name: Boyota Borolla
borolla.summary: The normal car. A dependable, affordable compact sedan with a 2.0L gas engine and room for five.
borolla.tagline: The car you forget about — because it just keeps going. A simple 2.0L engine, room for five, and nothing you don't need.
borolla.colors: Ember Red, Glacier White, Graphite, Harbor Blue
borolla.features.Gas, and nothing to learn: A 2.0L engine and a smooth automatic. Fill up, drive, repeat. No plugs, no new habits.
borolla.features.Boyota Guard 3.0: Lane keeping, pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise come standard on every trim.
borolla.features.A screen that stays out of the: A touchscreen with wireless phone mirroring, and real buttons for the climate.
borolla.sections.What it costs to own: 3 yr / 36,000 mi basic warranty, 5 yr / 60,000 mi powertrain warranty, 10k miles between services (est.), 2 yr roadside assistance. Cheap to buy, cheap to keep.

bauris.name: Boyota Bauris
bauris.summary: The Bauris hybrid liftback. Pulls away on electric, recharges as you brake. Plug-in on Limited.
bauris.tagline: Fewer stops for fuel, more room for the rest. A slippery liftback that pulls away on electric and recharges as you brake.
bauris.colors: Lane Teal, Glacier White, Graphite, Fjord Blue
bauris.features.Hybrid as standard: Every Bauris pairs a petrol engine with an electric motor. No settings to learn. It just uses less.
bauris.features.Plug in if you want: Limited adds a bigger battery and a charge port. Most daily drives can run on electric alone.
bauris.features.Shaped for the wind: A long, low roof and a cut-off tail let air slip past. That means less noise and fewer stops for fuel.
bauris.sections.How the hybrid works: Pulls away on electric in slow traffic, the petrol engine joins in when merging or climbing, and braking recharges the battery with no cable needed. Limited adds a plug-in battery for up to 44 miles on electric alone (est.).

bupra.name: Boyota Bupra
bupra.summary: The Boyota Bupra: a light, rear-drive 2-door sports coupe with launch control and a 6-speed manual.
bupra.tagline: Low, light and rear-wheel drive. Built for the long way home.
bupra.colors: Ember Red, Track Orange, Graphite, Frost White
bupra.features.Turbo straight-six: A 3.0-liter inline-six with a flat torque curve. Pulls hard from low revs to the limiter.
bupra.features.Balanced chassis: Front-engine, rear-drive, near 50:50 weight split. Adaptive dampers and a limited-slip differential.
bupra.features.Track ready: Big brakes, a cooling package and a built-in lap timer. Drive to the circuit, drive home.
bupra.sections.Track mode: One button for the circuit: launch control, sharper throttle, firmer dampers, looser stability control and a lap timer.
bupra.sections.Transmission: 6-speed manual with auto rev-matching (0–60 mph 4.1 s est.) or 8-speed automatic with paddles (0–60 mph 3.9 s est.).
